name: Promote skill to Staging
description: Copies a Dev skill into its Staging counterpart: description, instructions, and every stored file, replacing Staging's files. Keeps the Staging name and slug, and maps the Dev integration to the Staging one. Reads all Dev files before writing, so an unreadable file stops the transfer without changes.
failedLabel: Failed to promote skill to Staging

inputFields.label: Dev skill ID
inputFields.description: UUID of the Dev skill to copy from.

inputFields.label: Staging skill ID
inputFields.description: UUID of the Staging skill to overwrite. Never use a Prod ID.

inputFields.label: Dev integration ID
inputFields.description: UUID of the Dev Knowledge Retention integration. Actions from it are mapped to the Staging action with the same slug. Never use a Prod ID.

inputFields.label: Staging integration ID
inputFields.description: UUID of the Staging Knowledge Retention integration. Never use a Prod ID.
